title: api shard vitest timeout fixed by serial pool
l0: pnpm vitest --run packages/api timed out on the API shard.
l1: Set VITEST_POOL=serial before rerunning the package API shard to avoid worker starvation.

title: api shard schema cache timeout fixed by clearing tmp
l0: pnpm vitest packages/api --run timed out while loading stale schema cache.
l1: Clear packages/api/.tmp/schema-cache before rerunning when VITEST_API_TIMEOUT is paired with stale schema metadata.

title: playwright webkit download blocked by proxy
l0: playwright install webkit failed behind the corporate proxy.
l1: Set HTTPS_PROXY before running playwright install webkit on CI workers.
